contact.basis: Fixed independent AnnStreet-side exterior forecourt point selected before terrain and geometry, not a surveyed monument finished-floor datum.

verticalDatum: Public Terrarium composite source heights; provider-relative host visualization, not a surveyed local datum.
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in fixed native whole Shrine of Remembrance Brisbane frame. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.
limitations: Terrarium zoom15 output pixels may oversample much coarser native DEM.1m review grid and RGB encoding are not survey accuracy.

Coarse urban composite may not resolve plaza steps, pedestal slabs or adjacent walls; exact construction-grade classification is unspecified. Compatible host field required; default coarse terrain is not automatically certified.
